module_summary: AXI4-Lite slave exposing a 64-word register memory, with skid-buffered address/data channels and stall-aware ready/valid generation for full throughput.

anchors.name: slv_mem
anchors.why: 64x32 register memory written byte-wise via strobes and read into axi_rdata

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write data payload buffered in pre_wdata and stored into slv_mem

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data output driven from axi_rdata register

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid; set when address and data both valid, cleared by BREADY

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data valid driven by axi_rvalid; held while response stalled

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: Write address ready from axi_awready; loads pre_waddr skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: Write data ready from axi_wready; loads pre_wdata/pre_wstrb skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Read address ready from axi_arready; loads pre_raddr skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Write address, buffered and used to index slv_mem

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Read address, buffered in pre_raddr and selecting slv_mem word

anchors.name: read_response_stall
anchors.why: RVALID without RREADY; holds rvalid, blocks rdata update, drops arready

anchors.name: write_response_stall
anchors.why: BVALID without BREADY; stalls memory write and lowers awready/wready

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Write address valid feeding valid_write_address

anchors.name: S_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Write data valid feeding valid_write_data

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Read address valid feeding valid_read_request

anchors.name: S_AXI_BREADY
anchors.why: Master accepts write response; clears bvalid and write stall

anchors.name: S_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Master accepts read data; clears read_response_stall

anchors.name: S_AXI_WSTRB
anchors.why: Byte-lane write strobes buffered in pre_wstrb

anchors.name: valid_read_request
anchors.why: New or buffered read request pending; sets rvalid and enables read

anchors.name: valid_write_address
anchors.why: Write address available (new or buffered); gates memory write and bvalid

anchors.name: valid_write_data
anchors.why: Write data available (new or buffered); gates memory write and bvalid

anchors.name: pre_raddr
anchors.why: Read address skid buffer used while arready is low

anchors.name: pre_waddr
anchors.why: Write address skid buffer used while awready is low

anchors.name: pre_wdata
anchors.why: Write data skid buffer used while wready is low

anchors.name: rd_addr
anchors.why: Muxed read address (buffered or direct) indexing slv_mem

anchors.name: waddr
anchors.why: Muxed write address (buffered or direct) indexing slv_mem

groups.name: Register memory
groups.description: 64-word memory with byte-strobe writes and registered read data

groups.name: Write channel control
groups.description: Generates awready/wready/bvalid from valids and write response stall

groups.name: Read channel control
groups.description: Generates arready/rvalid and read enable from request and response stall

groups.name: Write skid buffers
groups.description: Holds write address/data/strobe when ready drops, muxing buffered or direct values

groups.name: Read skid buffer
groups.description: Holds read address when arready low and selects memory read address
